§3.0

Independent Research

Where I go when nobody hands me a spec — I have to find the problem first, then write it myself.

Reliability Framework for Quantized Vision-Language Models
2026 · Advised by Dr. K. E. Srinivasa Desikan
In review — IEEE
ProblemQuantized VLMs hallucinate more on edge hardware — a real product risk with no scoped fix.
ApproachNon-parametric density-drift detector + cost-aware two-tier inference cascade (GPU + CPU) — trading off latency, cost, and reliability, the same triangle product teams navigate shipping AI features.
ResultTwo rounds of external peer review completed; framework revised against critical feedback ahead of resubmission.
Formalizing Classical Indian Logic (IKS Institutional Internship)
Navya-Nyāya systems for computer science
Research
ApproachFormalized Navya-Nyāya epistemic structures — including epistemic Hoare logic with Pramāṇa tags and Abhāva-constrained minimization — as verifiable computational systems.

The through-line here is the same one running under every project above: a reliability claim is only as good as the framework you can check it against — whether that framework is 400 years old or was trained last quarter.
